B.narration:
You take out the bus ticket.

“1011”

That wasn't there when you put it in your pocket. The handwriting isn't yours.

The air grows thick, carrying the metallic scent of old rain and something else, something deeply, unnervingly wet.

prompt.content: You add one sentence of atmosphere to a quiet, literary horror story, in second person, present tense. Concrete senses only: sound, cold, light, smell, touch. No dialogue.

Where you are: your apartment, 6C. With you: no one. The power is out; the only light is the storm's. Something impossible has just happened, and you have gone very still.
Write ONE short sentence (under 20 words) about what you sense in the room. No names, no numbers, no quotes, no words in ALL CAPS, and don't explain anything.

D.narration:
Mara turns the key over in the dark. The paper tag catches the storm light.

“ROOFTOP”

That wasn't on the tag a minute ago. The handwriting isn't yours.

The silence presses against your skin, a heavy, suffocating blanket.

Where you are: the basement. With you: Mara. The power is out; the only light is the storm's. Something impossible has just happened, and you have gone very still.
Write ONE short sentence (under 20 words) about what you sense in the room. No names, no numbers, no quotes, no words in ALL CAPS, and don't explain anything.

ending.text:
You open the door.

The other night comes in quietly, the way Mara did. It smells like rain that never reached this building.

The two nights no longer agree about the brass key. Here, it is in Mara's hand, beside you. In the other night, it is with Mara, in the basement. Your bus ticket is in your hand, in both nights.

The worlds no longer agree on where Mara is. Here, she is beside you. In the other night, she is in the basement.

In 6D, Teo turns off his radio, and you hear him say, to no one, "Finally."

You look at what the night left you. "1011" on the bus ticket, in Mara's handwriting. "ROOFTOP" on the key's paper tag, in Mara's handwriting. Both made in a night you never lived.

Both nights are true now.
